content:
Today I chose issue #26771 for discussion!

Tracking Issue: Digraph Targets
Created by @Rida Hamadani (@Rida-Hamadani) on 2025-07-05
Labels: good first issue, t-combinatorics

Is this issue still relevant? Any recent updates? Anyone making progress?

I think the state of Digraph is not great right now: it's missing lots of defs and API (see #mathlib4 > Tournament has a Hamiltonian Path), but adding those will make it harder to add vertex sets to it (#33466 or #38476, both awaiting-author), and to move to an upcoming GraphLike class (#36743, #triage > PR !4#4127: refactor: create HasAdj class, define Digraph... @ 💬) that'll generalize existing SimpleGraph API to all graphs.

So unfortunately it seems like the best way to progress here is to do nothing for now :(

Snir Broshi said:

undefined

#33466 is the more up to date version at present. I added the other PRs history to it and responded to more reviews. If someone wants to take over and finish it I am fine with that.

Shreyas Srinivas said:

If someone wants to take over and finish it I am fine with that.

Hey, I thought you just took over it again 3 weeks ago from Alena Gusakov. I understand being busy, but could you clarify whether you do or don't consider yourself assigned to it? Or is the state "I'm on it but willing/want to hand it off" or similar?
I did, and I made some changes, but I am open to it being taken over again

Hi, I have created my own Digraph implementation with walks and paths and tournaments to prove that a hamiltonian path has a tournament. It’s part of my university project though so probably cannot open source until it is marked.
Hey nice to hear that. I think in this case adapting the existing mathlib definition is the best path forward.
